# Third-party code

Competitor code used for benchmarking. Only `mnp_training/` (with its
license) is tracked; clone the others locally to reproduce the comparisons:

- `crossNN/` — crossNN reference implementation and pretrained models
- `MethyLYZR/` — MethyLYZR reference implementation

Sturgeon is installed as a Python package (see `scripts/competitors/`). Each
tool remains under its own license.
